subject: Annie Oakley
hook: ANNIE OAKLEY IS NOT WHO YOU THINK
angle: Annie Oakley's rise to fame was built on a series of public myths, including the year she met her husband and her own age, which were manipulated to conceal that her husband was still legally married to another woman when they first met.
angle_support: The later marriage date would have better supported her fictional age.
A possible reason for the contradictory dates is that Butler's divorce from his first wife, Henrietta Saunders, was not yet final in 1876.
title: The Secret Scandal Behind Annie Oakley's Marriage
description: Annie Oakley's rise to stardom involved rewriting her own history. Official records reveal the true timeline of her marriage was hidden to protect her reputation.
narration: ANNIE OAKLEY IS NOT WHO YOU THINK You picture a frontier romance born in 1876. It was closer to a carefully manufactured public image. The records were manipulated to hide a major legal complication. Publicity claimed they wed in 1876, but official Canadian documents prove the ceremony occurred in 1882. This delay was likely necessary because her husband remained legally married to his first wife for years after their meeting. Her legendary backstory was built on a series of convenient lies.
